operations.description: The gotcha's manual-restore instruction is superseded: heal_local_settings.py now rebuilds the file at session start. Rewriting it accurate-and-shorter also pays for the gen-plan-index DoD line, since CLAUDE.md counts x4 against the context floor and had ~56 chars of headroom.
